desc: Derive the exact matching condition for a substring against `A*B*C`, including leading, middle, and trailing empty parts.
Implement a linear-time KMP occurrence finder for each nonempty literal segment.
Build sentinel-safe next-occurrence arrays for `B` and `C`, including empty-piece behavior at boundaries `0..n`.
Greedily evaluate every valid `A` start and compute the minimum candidate length via earliest compatible `B` then `C`.
Implement the Python `Solution.shortestMatchingSubstring` method using the starter-code signature.
Validate all samples and critical empty/overlap/absent-segment edge cases.
